chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Generosity is that which is by one’s own initiative, because giving on being asked is either out of self-respect or to avoid rebuke.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between true generosity and giving when asked?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates proactive giving (sakhā’) above reactive charity, arguing that giving upon request often stems from social pressure or modesty (ḥayā’) rather than pure intent. This distinction highlights the Shia emphasis on the sincerity of the heart (ikhlāṣ) and the virtue of initiating benevolence without expectation of recognition or obligation.
